text: Never put Stack.useSync on a single resource prop field (e.g. domain: Stack.useSync(...)). Alchemy Plan.resolveInput does not unwrap nested Effects, so the Effect object is sent to Cloudflare as hostname and deploy fails with SchemaError. Wrap the entire props object: Worker(id, Stack.useSync(({ stage }) => ({ ... })), impl).
prescription: Wrap entire InputProps object in Stack.useSync; set domain: stage === "prod" ? HOST : undefined inside.

text: Cloudflare Worker + SPA assets must set runWorkerFirst for /api/* (and /ingest). Without it, notFoundHandling single-page-application serves index.html for Better Auth callbacks; AuthBoundary then redirects to /auth?next=/api/auth/callback/google?code=… and OAuth never completes.
